verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at supabase.com that links to a full single-file corpus (llms-full.txt). The llms.txt also lists per-language reference corpora (js, python, swift, kotlin, dart, csharp, cli, api) and an explicit 'API and agent resources' section pointing to the OpenAPI spec and MCP endpoint. Beyond that, Supabase ships agent-oriented docs: Agent Skills, static prompt files for agents without MCP, a machine-discoverable /.well-known/agent-skills index, and per-page .md docs URLs. Missing for 10: the root docs.md returns 404, and there is no independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively.
